join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test (_CAPS_hello world_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] HELLO WORLD

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test (_CAPS_(_P_OR_test_)_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] TEST

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test This is a test.
send hortbot #foobar [HB] THIS IS A TEST.
